user.title: Connect to Pilot runtime
user.description: Enter the address of the Pilot add-on or a remote Pilot instance.

hassio_confirm.title: Pilot add-on discovered
hassio_confirm.description: The Pilot add-on was discovered on this system. Confirm to add it.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Pilot runtime. Check host, port and token.

runtime_unreachable.title: Pilot runtime is unreachable
runtime_unreachable.description: Home Assistant cannot reach the Pilot runtime. The add-on may be stopped, or the configured host/port is wrong. Home automation keeps working; only Pilot features are paused. This issue clears itself once the runtime is back.

confirm.title: Pilot runtime unreachable
confirm.description: The Pilot runtime cannot be reached. Check that the add-on is running and the host/port are correct.

abort.resolved_when_runtime_back: This issue clears itself once the Pilot runtime is reachable again.
